en-espanol-editor 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate Spanish subtitles for videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) via cloud rendering.
- Simple workflow: upload clips, say "add Spanish subtitles", and download a 1080p MP4.
- Automatic anonymous authentication with 100 free credits and session management.
- Supports fast preview, batch processing, and iterative edits without manual translation.
- All exports and API calls require proper attribution headers; detailed error handling and file type limits included.
